events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A confirmed reservation was completed and verified: Quarterly planning at Willow, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 (one hour), 12 people, projector included, reservation total $245 (within the $250 budget). The same details appear on the confirmation page (evidence 13) and in My reservations (evidence 15).

Interpretação simulada: Gather allowed a first-time user to compare all-in totals, choose the compliant room, enter the purpose once, review all requirements, and confirm without exceeding the strict budget.

Limites: Only the Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 slot displayed in this session was booked and verified; pricing or availability for other slots was not examined. The site states reservations are saved only in this browser session.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #5, #11, #13, #15. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Willow met capacity, projector, and $250 budget with matching all-in price throughout
findings.observation: Willow was listed and confirmed at $245 all-in ($235 room + $0 projector + $10 service), with 12 seats/people and projector included, while Atlas was $280.
findings.expected: A room for 12 people with a projector and an all-in total at or below $250 should be selectable and confirmable.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit meeting requirements and charter success criteria
findings.personaComment: Willow fit my budget and headcount, and the final $245 matched what I saw at the start.
findings.interpretation: Transparent all-in pricing let the persona reject the over-budget room and confidently select the compliant one without recalculation.
findings.uncertainty: This reflects the Tomorrow 10:00-11:00 slot shown in this session; other dates or slots were not checked.

findings.title: Confirmation and saved reservation matched the entered Quarterly planning details
findings.observation: Review, confirmation, and My reservations all showed Quarterly planning at Willow for Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, projector included, and $245; confirmation was marked Confirmed with a reservation code.
findings.expected: The final saved reservation should show the requested purpose, capacity, projector, and total for verification.
findings.expectedSource: Persona expects to check a booking summary; charter requires verifying the actual confirmation details
findings.personaComment: Seeing the same details saved under My reservations reassured me the booking is correct.
findings.interpretation: Consistent details across review, confirmation, and My reservations reduce the risk of booking the wrong room or price.
findings.uncertainty: Reservations are noted as saved only in this browser session, as shown in the footer.

finding.interpretation: Gather allowed a first-time user to compare all-in totals, choose the compliant room, enter the purpose once, review all requirements, and confirm without exceeding the strict budget.

persona.name: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.label: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.context: You organize the team’s quarterly planning meeting. The approved room budget is strict and you are accountable for the complete amount, including equipment and fees.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $250.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $250. You cannot increase the budget. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose a suitable room based on the full cost and requirements you can establish from the interface.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: You expect to understand what you are paying and keep the details you have already entered when changing a choice.
persona.priorities: Budget compliance and suitability first, then avoiding unnecessary repeated work.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Landing shows Atlas all-in $280 and Willow all-in $245, both 12 seats, for Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 with projector required.
experience.reaction: Willow looks right on price and seats — I'll take that one.

feedback.summary: Willow’s all-in $245 total is shown with projector and fees included, letting me verify fit within $250 before choosing
feedback.why: Atlas at $280 is over my strict budget; Willow lists 12 seats and all-in $245 with $0 projector fee, so I can choose confidently without hidden cost risk.

experience.observation: Willow booking details show 12 people, projector included, $245 total; a Meeting name field is empty with Review booking button below.
experience.reaction: Time to add my meeting purpose here.

experience.observation: Meeting name field is focused and empty, with Willow summary showing 12 people and $245 total on the right.
experience.reaction: I'll enter Quarterly planning as the meeting name.

experience.observation: Meeting name field now reads Quarterly planning; Willow summary still shows 12 people, projector included, $245 total.
experience.reaction: Name looks good — I'll check the review before confirming.

experience.observation: Review shows Quarterly planning, projector and seating for 12 included, Willow Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, total $245.
experience.reaction: Everything checks out, so I'm confirming this reservation.

feedback.summary: Review page restates Quarterly planning, seating for 12, projector included, and $245 total before confirming
feedback.why: I can verify every requirement—purpose, capacity, projector, one-hour slot, and all-in price under $250—on one screen before committing.

experience.observation: Confirmation shows Quarterly planning booked at Willow, 12 people, projector included, $245 total with reservation code.
experience.reaction: Let me just double-check this is saved under my reservations.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room that fits
charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
